<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def raw(i,j):
    r0,c0=15+3*i,15+3*j
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter()
    for dr in range(3):
        for dc in range(3): cnt[rows[r0+dr][c0+dc]]+=1
    return cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
grid=[[raw(i,j) for j in range(11)] for i in range(11)]
floor=set('WgNb')
def isf(r,c): return 0<=r<11 and 0<=c<11 and grid[r][c] in floor
def hop(r,c,dr,dc):
    a=(r+dr,c+dc); b=(r+2*dr,c+2*dc)
    return b if isf(*a) and isf(*b) else None
from collections import deque
start,goal=(6,2),(10,10)
dirs={(-1,0):'UP',(1,0):'DOWN',(0,-1):'LEFT',(0,1):'RIGHT'}
prev={start:None}; q=deque([start])
while q:
    cur=q.popleft()
    for (dr,dc),nm in dirs.items():
        n=hop(*cur,dr,dc)
        if n and n not in prev: prev[n]=(cur,nm); q.append(n)
print("goal reachable?", goal in prev)
if goal in prev:
    cur=goal; seq=[]
    while cur!=start:
        p,nm=prev[cur]; seq.append(nm); cur=p
    seq.reverse(); print("REMAINING:", seq, "len", len(seq))
    # verify
    D={'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}
    pos=start
    for nm in seq:
        dr,dc=D[nm]; a=(pos[0]+dr,pos[1]+dr*0+dc*0,pos[1]); 
        a=(pos[0]+dr,pos[1]+dc); b=(pos[0]+2*dr,pos[1]+2*dc)
        assert isf(*a) and isf(*b), (nm,pos)
        pos=b
    print("verify final", pos)
    res=action(seq)
    print("done:",last_action_result.get('done'),"lc:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            print("player now", (r0-15)//3,(c0-15)//3)
    print("step",current_frame.step,"level",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
